channel_rule: scan 1..20 in snake order; skip cleared channels; stop refining a known channel at MEC<=19m for P3 or <=60m for P4; stop unknown channels after 16 sources
direction_rule: intersect arena, 1500m disks and all +/-1deg bearing wedges
clear_rule: MEC centre if radius<=19m; P3 probes the MEC centre once at radius<=40m; P4 first uses guaranteed symmetric receiver pairs; otherwise use a 19m triangular cover of the feasible polygon
execution: run robot_strategy.py; each next HTTP request depends on the previous response
